title: A/R Detail: the PDF and CSV print an as-of date after today
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a customer, customer A, with an open invoice dated today, so the exports have a row.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only customer A ticked in the Customer filter.
custom_steps:
1. Click the date chip ("As of: " and today's date).
  2. Pick the last day of next month in the calendar.
  3. Click the ⋯ Export button ("Export report") at the right of the title row.
  4. Click "Download (PDF)".
  5. Open the downloaded PDF.
  6. Click the ⋯ Export button ("Export report") again.
  7. Click "Download (CSV)".
  8. Open the downloaded CSV file in a spreadsheet program.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A calendar opens with today's date selected.

Step 2:

  • The chip reads "As of: " and the last day of next month.
  • The report reloads for that day, and customer A's invoice is still listed.

Step 3:

  • The menu shows "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".

Step 4:

  • A PDF file downloads.

Step 5:

  • The as-of line reads "As of " and the last day of next month: three-letter month, day, four-digit year (for example "As of Dec 31, 2026"), not today's date.
  • Customer A's invoice is in the PDF.

Step 6:

  • The menu shows "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)".

Step 7:

  • A CSV file downloads.

Step 8:

  • The as-of line reads "As of: " and the same day (for example "As of: Dec 31, 2026"), not today's date.
  • Customer A's invoice is in the CSV.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (13 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026, version re-checked 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R10b: “The as-of date can be any day, including a day after today, as today. For a day after today the report counts everything entered so far and counts days past due to the picked day; the chip, the PDF and the CSV all show the picked day. A link with an as-of date opens on that date.”
  • S3-R4: “Each export states the as-of date the user picked: the PDF "As of Oct 15, 2026", the CSV "As of: Oct 15, 2026" (format: three-letter month, day, four-digit year).”
  • S3-R1: “Each of the six reports has the native report Export menu (the ⋯ button at the right of the title row, labelled "Export report") with "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)". A/R's former Print button is replaced by this menu. The A/P reports gain a PDF.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html); page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design pictures the date chip but no day after today and no export file (all 7 boards checked, design version of 5 Nov 2026); the results follow the PRD.
